convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (ColorXdinMA) and external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for both smoothing logic and trade execution/money management. Custom indicator with proprietary smoothing methods requires manual reconstruction.

derived_values.name: StartBars1 - minimum bars for main MA
StartBars2 - minimum bars for plus MA
TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime trade signal timestamps

other_exits: Buy closed on bearish signal (Value[1]>Value[2]) when BuyPosClose=true
Sell closed on bullish signal (Value[1]<Value[2]) when SellPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses. MM=0.1 interpreted as 0.1 lots when MMMode=LOT, or as percentage fraction for other modes.

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads 3 consecutive values from ColorXdinMA buffer at offsets SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2. Signal logic: if Value[1]<Value[2] (MA declining at bar+1 vs bar+2) AND Value[0]>Value[1] (MA turning up at current bar), then bullish signal (buy open + sell close). Conversely, if Value[1]>Value[2] AND Value[0]<Value[1], then bearish signal (sell open + buy close). This is a dual-MA-turn detection: the ColorXdinMA indicator embeds two smoothing lengths (Length_main and Length_plus), and buffer values reflect their interaction. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans allow independent toggling of each direction's entry and exit. Signal is recalculated on new bar OR when SignalBar==0 (every tick). Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are passed to trade functions for potential time-based validation. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up global variables on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorXdinMA custom indicator must be fully reimplemented in Python. It uses the CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which implements 10+ smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA). The XdinMA algorithm itself combines two MA lengths (main and plus) with a Phase parameter for adaptive smoothing. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with margin-mode-dependent lot sizing - this must also be ported. The signal logic (3-bar turn detection) is straightforward once the indicator is ported. Deviation of 10 points is used for slippage control. No digit adjustment is performed on SL/TP - they are raw point values (1000 and 2000 points respectively).
